where.if: AND (device_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR device_sn LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select:
SELECT id, event_time, event_type, event_tag, device_id, device_sn, device_status, event_level, content, order_no, process_status, process_remark, processed_by, processed_time FROM device_event
ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO device_info( device_id, device_sn, device_name, device_status, device_type, province, city, county, community, address, remarks, create_time, update_time ) VALUES( #{deviceId}, #{deviceSn}, #{deviceName}, #{deviceStatus}, #{deviceType}, #{province}, #{city}, #{county}, #{community}, #{address}, #{remarks}, now(), now() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE device_sn = VALUES(device_sn), device_name = VALUES(device_name), device_status = VALUES(device_status), device_type = VALUES(device_type), province = VALUES(province), city = VALUES(city), county = VALUES(county), community = VALUES(community), address = VALUES(address), remarks = VALUES(remarks), update_time = now()

INSERT INTO gate_info(gate_id, device_id, device_sn, gate_name, gate_code, sort, gate_status, create_time, update_time, remarks) VALUES(#{gateId}, #{deviceId}, #{deviceSn}, #{gateName}, #{gateCode}, #{sort}, #{gateStatus}, now(), now(), #{remarks}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE gate_name = VALUES(gate_name), gate_code = VALUES(gate_code), sort = VALUES(sort), gate_status = VALUES(gate_status), remarks = VALUES(remarks), update_time = now()
mapper.update: UPDATE device_event SET process_status = 'DONE', process_remark = #{remark}, processed_by = #{operator}, processed_time = now() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO device_event( event_id, event_time, event_type, event_tag, device_id, device_sn, device_status, event_level, content, process_status, raw_payload, create_time ) VALUES( concat('EVT-', date_format(now(), '%Y%m%d%H%i%s'), '-', floor(rand() * 10000)), now(), #{eventType}, #{eventTag}, #{deviceId}, #{deviceSn}, #{deviceStatus}, #{eventLevel}, #{content}, 'CREATED', #{rawPayload}, now() )
